items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Erskine Tayback across the street at the Vind Dome Theater

ctx.x: So it was a whole dichotomy in that area where many people felt to get ahead you had to be more like white then like black.

That‟s right, that‟s exactly… and so the epitome of the two theaters there, was that it was the Dave Payton theater… Dave Payton at the Grand Theater and Erskine Tayback across the street at the Vind Dome Theater. Now of course the other subservient theaters, they had the Monogram, which was a comic place where they had all the comedians. Then we had…
What kind of comedians did they have in those days?
